content.what_it_is: MATLAB generator for a 500x500, 2 m grid with a 10 m annular water region, linearly sloped inner island and outer beach, and elevations capped at -2 (L3-L35). It also constructs a vessel trajectory whose radius ramps from 60 to 250 before following the 250-radius circle, plots the path, shifts coordinates to the grid origin, and saves depth.txt plus vessel_0001 (L37-L71).
entities: grid dimensions m and n defined at L3-L4
grid spacings dx and dy defined at L5-L6
centered coordinate vectors x and y defined at L8-L9
coordinate grids X and Y defined at L11
outer/inner radii R1 and R2 defined at L13-L14
slopes Slope and Slope_is defined at L15-L16
depth grid dep initialized at L18 and modified at L24, L27, and L32
loop indices j and i defined at L20-L21
cell radius r defined at L22
initial route radius Rs defined at L37
initial ship coordinates x0 and y0 defined at L38-L39
nominal speed speed0 defined at L40
time vector t defined at L42
trajectory arrays xship and yship initialized at L43-L44
target route radius Rship defined at L45
actual-step speed array actsp initialized at L46
ramp time t0 defined at L47
trajectory loop index it defined at L49
instantaneous radius rship assigned at L51 and L53
angular speed omega defined at L55
angle defined at L56
trajectory coordinates updated at L57-L58
actual step speed actsp updated at L59
three-column vessel array constructed at L65-L67

equations.ref: radial distance of each grid cell
constant angular rate based on target radius

io.name: negated depth pcolor and vessel path

unresolved: Nominal/actual speed mismatch across L40, L51, L55, and L59: speed0 sets only angular rate using the final Rship, while the radius changes during t<t0, so total vessel speed includes radial motion and tangential speed rship*speed0/Rship. actsp measures that differing speed but is omitted from output at L68.

Potential orientation/interface defect at L42-L44 and L65-L67: t, xship, and yship are created as row vectors and assigned directly to vessel(:,k) column slices without transposition; compatibility depends on MATLAB indexed-assignment shape handling and is not guarded.

Grid centering at L8-L9 subtracts m/2*dx and n/2*dy from indices 0..m-1 and 0..n-1, giving even-sized ranges -500..498 rather than symmetric endpoint coordinates; the saved ship shift at L66-L67 follows the same origin convention, but the intended cell-center/edge convention is undocumented.
MATLAB pcolor at L35 ordinarily omits the final matrix row and column as colored faces; this affects only the preview, not the saved depth array.
